title: "Module 03: Single-cell RNA-seq normalization, clustering, and differential expression analysis"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-06"
---

```{r}

#==============================================================================
# MODULE 03 — Single-cell normalization, clustering, and DEA
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Normalize the QC-filtered single-cell RNA-seq dataset, identify variable
#   genes, perform PCA, assess sample-associated effects using UMAP, evaluate
#   Harmony as a diagnostic batch-correction strategy, cluster cells using
#   uncorrected PCA, characterize cluster composition, and identify cluster
#   marker genes.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/single_cell/GSE298688_QC_filtered_seurat.rds
#
# Output:
#   data/processed/single_cell/GSE298688_processed_clustered_seurat.rds
#   results/single_cell/processing/
#   results/single_cell/cluster_markers/
#   figures/single_cell/processing/
#   figures/single_cell/cluster_markers/
#
# Important:
#   Harmony is used only to assess potential sample-associated effects.
#   Final graph construction, clustering, UMAP, and DEA use the
#   uncorrected PCA representation.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(harmony)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis parameters

normalization_scale_factor <- 10000
number_variable_features <- 2000
number_pcs <- 50
analysis_dimensions <- 1:30
clustering_resolution <- 0.5

harmony_group_variable <- "sample"

marker_min_pct <- 0.10
marker_log2fc_threshold <- 0.25
adjusted_p_threshold <- 0.05
top_markers_per_cluster <- 10


# Repository paths

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

processing_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "processing"
)

marker_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "cluster_markers"
)

processing_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "processing"
)

marker_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "cluster_markers"
)

volcano_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "cluster_markers",
  "volcano_plots"
)

for (directory in c(
  processed_directory,
  processing_results_directory,
  marker_results_directory,
  processing_figure_directory,
  marker_figure_directory,
  volcano_figure_directory
)) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_QC_filtered_seurat.rds"
)

processed_object_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_processed_clustered_seurat.rds"
)


# Helper for consistently saving figures.

save_plot <- function(
  plot,
  directory,
  filename,
  width = 7,
  height = 6
) {

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      directory,
      filename
    ),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load QC-filtered object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 02 output not found: ",
    input_file
  )
}

message("Loading QC-filtered single-cell object...")

single_cell <- readRDS(input_file)

DefaultAssay(single_cell) <- "RNA"


required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "percent.mt"
)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(single_cell@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required metadata: ",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


# Join Seurat v5 RNA layers before normalization and DEA.

if (
  length(
    Layers(
      single_cell[["RNA"]]
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  message("Joining RNA assay layers...")

  single_cell <- JoinLayers(
    single_cell,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


message(
  "Loaded: ",
  nrow(single_cell),
  " genes x ",
  ncol(single_cell),
  " cells"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Normalize expression and perform PCA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Normalizing RNA expression...")

single_cell <- NormalizeData(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = normalization_scale_factor,
  verbose = FALSE
)


single_cell <- FindVariableFeatures(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = number_variable_features,
  verbose = FALSE
)


variable_feature_plot <- VariableFeaturePlot(
  single_cell
) +
  labs(
    title = "Highly Variable Genes"
  )

print(variable_feature_plot)

save_plot(
  variable_feature_plot,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_variable_features.png",
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)


# Scale highly variable genes for dimensionality reduction.

single_cell <- ScaleData(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  features = VariableFeatures(single_cell),
  verbose = FALSE
)


single_cell <- RunPCA(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  features = VariableFeatures(single_cell),
  npcs = number_pcs,
  verbose = FALSE
)


# Retain the elbow plot to document PC selection.

elbow_plot <- ElbowPlot(
  single_cell,
  ndims = number_pcs
) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA Elbow Plot"
  )

print(elbow_plot)

save_plot(
  elbow_plot,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_PCA_elbow_plot.png",
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Assess sample-associated effects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generate an uncorrected PCA-based UMAP before Harmony correction.

message("Generating uncorrected UMAP for batch assessment...")

single_cell <- RunUMAP(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap_uncorrected",
  reduction.key = "UMAPuncorrected_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


uncorrected_umap_sample <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggtitle(
    "Uncorrected UMAP by Sample"
  )


uncorrected_umap_condition <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggtitle(
    "Uncorrected UMAP by Experimental Condition"
  )


print(uncorrected_umap_sample)
print(uncorrected_umap_condition)


save_plot(
  uncorrected_umap_sample,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_uncorrected_UMAP_by_sample.png"
)

save_plot(
  uncorrected_umap_condition,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_uncorrected_UMAP_by_condition.png"
)


# Run Harmony as a diagnostic comparison only.
# Harmony is not used for final clustering or DEA.

message(
  "Running diagnostic Harmony correction using: ",
  harmony_group_variable
)

single_cell <- harmony::RunHarmony(
  object = single_cell,
  group.by.vars = harmony_group_variable,
  reduction.use = "pca",
  dims.use = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.save = "harmony",
  project.dim = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)


# Generate a Harmony-based UMAP for direct comparison.

single_cell <- RunUMAP(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "harmony",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap_harmony",
  reduction.key = "UMAPharmony_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


harmony_umap_sample <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap_harmony",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  labs(
    title = "Harmony UMAP by Sample"
  )


harmony_umap_condition <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap_harmony",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  labs(
    title = "Harmony UMAP by Experimental Condition"
  )


print(harmony_umap_sample)
print(harmony_umap_condition)


save_plot(
  harmony_umap_sample,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_Harmony_UMAP_by_sample.png"
)

save_plot(
  harmony_umap_condition,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_Harmony_UMAP_by_condition.png"
)


# Compare sample and condition structure before and after Harmony.

batch_correction_comparison <- (
  uncorrected_umap_sample |
  harmony_umap_sample
) / (
  uncorrected_umap_condition |
  harmony_umap_condition
)

print(batch_correction_comparison)

save_plot(
  batch_correction_comparison,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_batch_correction_comparison.png",
  width = 14,
  height = 12
)


message(
  "Harmony assessment complete. ",
  "Final downstream analysis remains PCA-based."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Cluster cells using uncorrected PCA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Constructing PCA-based nearest-neighbor graph and clusters..."
)

single_cell <- FindNeighbors(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  verbose = FALSE
)

single_cell <- FindClusters(
  single_cell,
  resolution = clustering_resolution,
  random.seed = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


number_clusters <- length(
  unique(
    single_cell$seurat_clusters
  )
)

message(
  "Clusters identified: ",
  number_clusters
)

print(
  table(
    single_cell$seurat_clusters
  )
)


# Generate the final PCA-based UMAP.

single_cell <- RunUMAP(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap",
  reduction.key = "UMAP_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


cluster_umap <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle(
    "Seurat Clusters"
  )


sample_umap <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggtitle(
    "UMAP by Sample"
  )


condition_umap <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggtitle(
    "UMAP by Experimental Condition"
  )


print(cluster_umap)
print(sample_umap)
print(condition_umap)


save_plot(
  cluster_umap,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_UMAP_clusters.png"
)

save_plot(
  sample_umap,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_UMAP_by_sample.png"
)

save_plot(
  condition_umap,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_UMAP_by_condition.png"
)


umap_overview <- (
  cluster_umap |
  sample_umap |
  condition_umap
)

print(umap_overview)

save_plot(
  umap_overview,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_UMAP_overview.png",
  width = 18,
  height = 6
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Examine cluster composition
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_counts <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    seurat_clusters,
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "n_cells"
  )


cluster_proportions <- cluster_counts %>%
  group_by(
    seurat_clusters
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_of_cluster =
      100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


print(cluster_proportions)


write.csv(
  cluster_proportions,
  file.path(
    processing_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_cluster_sample_composition.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cluster_composition_plot <- ggplot(
  cluster_proportions,
  aes(
    x = seurat_clusters,
    y = percent_of_cluster,
    fill = sample
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sample Composition of Seurat Clusters",
    x = "Seurat cluster",
    y = "Cells within cluster (%)",
    fill = "Sample"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(cluster_composition_plot)

save_plot(
  cluster_composition_plot,
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_cluster_sample_composition.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Cluster-level differential expression analysis
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Running cluster-level differential expression analysis..."
)

DefaultAssay(single_cell) <- "RNA"
Idents(single_cell) <- "seurat_clusters"


# Ensure normalized RNA expression is represented by a joined layer before DEA.

rna_layers <- Layers(
  single_cell[["RNA"]]
)

if (
  sum(
    grepl(
      "^data",
      rna_layers
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  single_cell <- JoinLayers(
    single_cell,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


# Compare each Seurat cluster with all remaining cells.

cluster_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.pct = marker_min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = marker_log2fc_threshold,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  verbose = FALSE
)


if (nrow(cluster_markers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No cluster marker genes were identified."
  )
}


if (!"gene" %in% colnames(cluster_markers)) {
  cluster_markers$gene <- rownames(
    cluster_markers
  )
}


write.csv(
  cluster_markers,
  file.path(
    marker_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_cluster_markers_all.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Summarize significant positive and negative markers by cluster.

marker_summary <- cluster_markers %>%
  group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_markers = n(),

    positive_markers = sum(
      avg_log2FC > 0 &
        p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    negative_markers = sum(
      avg_log2FC < 0 &
        p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(marker_summary)


write.csv(
  marker_summary,
  file.path(
    marker_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_cluster_marker_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Select top significant positive markers for each cluster.

top_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_val_adj),
    p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
    avg_log2FC > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = avg_log2FC,
    n = top_markers_per_cluster,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


if (nrow(top_markers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No significant positive cluster markers were available for visualization."
  )
}


write.csv(
  top_markers,
  file.path(
    marker_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_top10_cluster_markers.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Visualize cluster markers
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Scale selected marker genes for heatmap visualization.

heatmap_genes <- intersect(
  unique(
    top_markers$gene
  ),
  rownames(single_cell)
)


single_cell <- ScaleData(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  features = heatmap_genes,
  verbose = FALSE
)


cluster_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  single_cell,
  features = heatmap_genes,
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  size = 3
) +
  NoLegend()


print(cluster_heatmap)


save_plot(
  cluster_heatmap,
  marker_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_top10_cluster_marker_heatmap.png",
  width = 14,
  height = 12
)


# Generate one volcano plot per Seurat cluster.

cluster_ids <- sort(
  unique(
    cluster_markers$cluster
  )
)


message(
  "Generating volcano plots for ",
  length(cluster_ids),
  " clusters..."
)


for (cluster_id in cluster_ids) {

  cluster_de <- cluster_markers %>%
    filter(
      cluster == cluster_id
    ) %>%
    mutate(

      significance = case_when(

        !is.na(p_val_adj) &
          p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
          avg_log2FC >= marker_log2fc_threshold ~
          "Upregulated",

        !is.na(p_val_adj) &
          p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
          avg_log2FC <= -marker_log2fc_threshold ~
          "Downregulated",

        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),

      plot_p = pmax(
        p_val_adj,
        .Machine$double.xmin,
        na.rm = FALSE
      ),

      neg_log10_p = -log10(
        plot_p
      )
    )


  volcano_labels <- cluster_de %>%
    filter(
      significance == "Upregulated"
    ) %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = avg_log2FC,
      n = top_markers_per_cluster,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )


  volcano_plot <- ggplot(
    cluster_de,
    aes(
      x = avg_log2FC,
      y = neg_log10_p
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(
        color = significance
      ),
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.5
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(
        -marker_log2fc_threshold,
        marker_log2fc_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(
        adjusted_p_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = volcano_labels,
      aes(
        label = gene
      ),
      size = 3.2,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
        "Downregulated" = "#4575B4",
        "Not significant" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Differential Expression of Seurat Cluster ",
        cluster_id
      ),
      subtitle = "Cluster compared with all remaining cells",
      x = "Average log2 fold change",
      y = expression(
        -log[10](
          "adjusted p-value"
        )
      ),
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 11,
        color = "grey35"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left"
    )


  print(volcano_plot)


  save_plot(
    volcano_plot,
    volcano_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      "GSE298688_cluster_",
      cluster_id,
      "_volcano.png"
    ),
    width = 7,
    height = 6
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_parameters <- data.frame(

  parameter = c(
    "normalization_method",
    "normalization_scale_factor",
    "variable_features",
    "pca_components",
    "analysis_dimensions",
    "clustering_resolution",
    "harmony_group_variable",
    "harmony_assessment",
    "batch_correction_used_for_final_analysis",
    "final_graph_reduction",
    "final_visualization",
    "marker_test",
    "marker_min_pct",
    "marker_log2fc_threshold",
    "adjusted_p_threshold",
    "top_markers_per_cluster"
  ),

  value = c(
    "LogNormalize",
    normalization_scale_factor,
    number_variable_features,
    number_pcs,
    paste0(
      min(analysis_dimensions),
      ":",
      max(analysis_dimensions)
    ),
    clustering_resolution,
    harmony_group_variable,
    "Diagnostic only; reduction retained",
    "None",
    "PCA",
    "UMAP",
    "Wilcoxon",
    marker_min_pct,
    marker_log2fc_threshold,
    adjusted_p_threshold,
    top_markers_per_cluster
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  analysis_parameters,
  file.path(
    processing_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_processing_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save processed object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  single_cell,
  processed_object_file
)


message(
  "Module 03 complete: ",
  ncol(single_cell),
  " cells; ",
  length(
    VariableFeatures(single_cell)
  ),
  " variable genes; ",
  number_clusters,
  " clusters; ",
  nrow(cluster_markers),
  " marker results."
)


message(
  "Final clustering and DEA are PCA-based; ",
  "Harmony is retained for diagnostic comparison only."
)


message(
  "Saved processed object: ",
  processed_object_file
)
```
